temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa seems overburdened with her tasks during the community service project and appears overwhelmed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He has no specific prior belief about Teresa being overwhelmed; he becomes aware of her heavy workload.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—he forms the belief that Teresa needs help and that her well-being is at risk.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa is overburdened and needs assistance, so he should offer help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer his assistance with her tasks.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa accepts his help but expresses that she wants to prove she can do things by herself; Arthur reassures her that accepting help does not undermine her capability.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability; he feels empathetic toward her self-reliance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Teresa confirms her desire to prove herself, then agrees with his reassurance that teamwork matters.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa better understands that accepting help does not diminish her ability, and she is more open to teamwork.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathetic and supportive; somewhat reassured and encouraged.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Teresa and support her without undermining her sense of capability.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa admits she is still having a busy day and feels like she is falling behind despite earlier reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After reassuring her, he believed Teresa understood his support and was more open to teamwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—he now believes Teresa is still struggling and his previous efforts have not yielded enough results.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: A different, fully collaborative approach may be needed to share the load and help Teresa effectively.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Find another way to support Teresa by proposing that they work together as a team without making her feel inadequate.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees that working together is already less overwhelming and accepts the plan to divide tasks and check in regularly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Working together as a team may help ease Teresa's burden and improve efficiency.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Teresa's positive response confirms that collaboration is easing the burden.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The collaborative approach is effective and will make things easier for both of them.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Fully commit to the collaborative approach and keep momentum going.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa says their teamwork paid off, calls it a great experience, and agrees to continue the collaborative approach in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: The collaborative approach is effective and promising for their current work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—the successful day confirms that collaboration has strengthened their professional relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Collaboration should be maintained in future projects because it improved efficiency and their working relationship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the collaborative approach in future projects with Teresa.
